description: Configuration script for GCC runtime libraries, defining build options, dependencies, and test procedures within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build environment.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment for libgcc and runtime targets, creating dummy libraries and running configuration scripts.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the runtime libraries for libgcc and other targets.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled runtime libraries into the destination directory, cleaning up include directories and info files.

methods.name: do_check
methods.description: Runs the test suite for the build, setting environment variables and handling dependencies.
